description: This file defines the EntityListCache class, which manages caching of entity lists based on conditions and ordering within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityListCache
classes.description: A cache class for storing lists of GenericValue entities based on entity name, condition, and order.

methods.name: EntityListCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache with a delegator name.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a list of GenericValue objects for a given entity and condition, with optional ordering.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a list of entities in the cache for a given entity and condition.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes cached list for a specific entity, condition, and order.

methods.name: getOrderByKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key based on the orderBy list.
